nodes.text: HMPV primarily causes upper & lower respiratory infections with symptoms ranging from mild cold-like signs to severe conditions like bronchitis & pneumonia. Vulnerable groups, incl young children, the elderly, & immunocompromised individuals, are at higher risk of severe illness.
